emma_finance: Heads-up  month-end revenue schedule shows zero deferred for customer AURORA-1, but billing export shows a $120,000 prepay invoice for Dedicated Reserved Capacity on 2024-04-02. Looks like system posted full revenue instead of deferring. Need recommendation and sign-off for correction JE.

suresh_acct: Please paste invoice IDs and contract term so I can validate rev schedule.

emma_finance: From billing export:
INV-2024-0587, 120000, invoice_date: 2024-04-02, product: Dedicated Reserved Capacity
INV-2024-0588, 30000, invoice_date: 2024-04-02, product: Support addon
Only INV-2024-0587 should be deferred over 12 months (10k/mo). System posted full 120k to revenue on 4/2.

jordan_revops: That matches the April revenue spike vs forecast. Suggest reversing the 120k recognition in April, post Deferred Revenue 120k, then amortize monthly per contract term.

emma_finance: Draft JEs:
1) 2024-04-30 correction:
Dr: Revenue 120,000
Cr: Deferred Revenue 120,000
Narrative: Reverse improper recognition of AURORA-1 reserved capacity prepay.
2) Depending on contract start, record April amortization if revenue should begin 4/1:
Dr: Deferred Revenue 10,000
Cr: Revenue 10,000
Net April P&L impact after correction: revenue down 110k.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0587 status: paid 2024-04-05. Link: https://billing.internal/invoices/INV-2024-0587

suresh_acct: Need signed SOW or order to confirm term start. Also confirm GL accounts: Rev 4001, Deferred Rev 2305. Attach docs to GL Close folder.

maya_sales: SOW countersigned 2024-03-28, term starts 2024-04-01 per clause 2.1. PO is PO-90877 (attached). Sales wanted revenue from 4/1. Customer not disputing.

jordan_revops: Ops request: add guardrail so reserved capacity invoices are flagged for deferral at creation. Will open a billing ticket. @billing-bot please create.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4132: "reserved_capacity: default deferral flag for prepay invoices" assigned to billing-team. https://issues.internal/BILL-4132

emma_finance: Next steps: Suresh to review & post JE, Emma to upload invoice PDF, SOW, billing CSV, and memo to Close/2024-04/AURORA-1. React with :white_check_mark: when you approve the JE.

suresh_acct: :white_check_mark: I will post today and add the JE batch number.

emma_finance: Thanks everyone. I'll update the revenue schedule after JE posts and confirm P&L change.
